label: Quote Block
description: An editorial pull quote at display size: a brand quote glyph, the quote rising line by line (a highlighted phrase takes the brand color), a drawn rule and the attribution. Sits on the scene ground by default; surface 'card' puts it on a card.

highlight.label: A phrase copied exactly from the quote to set in the brand color

theme.label: Card theme; omit to follow the scene ground (a dark ground gets a dark card)

at.label: Seconds into the scene the card enters (default 0.2)

exit.label: Fade out before the scene ends (default: hold; the cut is the exit)
